title: Powers and Functions of Additional Director-General and Other Officers

content.scenario: The Additional Director-General of the consumer protection authority wants to exercise his powers and discharge his functions independently.
content.outcome: The Additional Director-General shall exercise his powers and discharge his functions subject to the general control, supervision, and direction of the Director-General, as per the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What are the powers and functions of the Additional Director-General?
Is the Additional Director-General independent in exercising his powers?
What is the role of the Director-General in relation to the Additional Director-General?
